translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: 2 Timotius
book.title: Surat Ni Paulus Men Kopinduan Boni TIMOTIUS

content: Imamat pore-pore! Na ilio kokomburi'anna bo taka a tempo men marepa tuu'.
Mian somo mingimamat waka-wakanamo ka' loingonkon doi'. Raaya'a lambak ka' mintidaa-daa, raaya'a tongko' momotaekon, sian mangangga'i minti'i, sian minginti'i polingu'na mian, ka' sian bakitumpu,
sian minginti'i molingu'kon mian, bude' pooka'amat, mingkira' mingiroki mian, sian momoko mandagai waka, mimuruk, bude'kon men pore.

Raaya'a mingkira' mimpali' na upa men ia tundunmo, mingilimang men sambu-sambumo, ka' kominti-minti. Raaya'a tongko' mingkikira'i malolo' na pingkira'na noa, ka' bude' malolo' na pingkira'na Alaata'ala.
Kalu tongko' bo piile'on, raaya'a uga' bakitumpu. Kasee men tuutuu'na i raaya'a mongkosiankon kuasana Tumpu. Parerei a mian men koiya'a.
Gause na ko'ona i raaya'a isian mian men mindolat na laiganna mian sambana ka' mambaetok wiwine men sian moonggor a imaanna, men biai' a dosana ka' men bariosonna pingkira' ba'idek.
Raaya'a sinampang moki pisiso', kasee sia-sianapo momoko minginti'i men kana'.
Koimo i Yanes tii Yambres nanggagai i Musa, koiya'a uga' i raaya'a mongkokundai men kana'. Noana i raaya'a ba'idek ka' imaanna i raaya'a sian tuutuu'.
Ka' raaya'a sabole sian kowaa-waara'aanna, gause koi i Yanes tii Yambres, mbaka' kabobo'anna i raaya'a bo kanginti'ian na giigii' mian.
Potoo kada' sinampang montontoni Alkitaap men molinas
Kasee koo daa ninginti'imo pisiso'ku, tutuo'ku, ka' koi upa pontontoningku upa men yaku' parasayamo, sian sungkol, ka' koi upa a polingu'ku na mian ka' kotaananna noangku.

Koo daa nimiile'mo repaan men yaku' lolongi gause nitalalais. Koo ninginti'imo giigii' iya'a men yaku' tempoi na Antiokhia tia na Ikonium ka' na Listra, kasee daa Tumpu nangalaweimo i yaku' na repaan iya'a.
Koiya'a mba'a a sanda' mian men mingkira' malolo' ka' moto kantang tii Kristus Yesus. Ia bo talalaison,
kasee mian men ba'idek a gau'na tia mian kelo-kelos tongko' kaekae' minturang a idekna i raaya'a. Raaya'a tongko' mambaetok mian ka' uga' bo baetokonna mian.
Kasee i koo tio sinampang montontoni upa men kana' men ia pisiso'konmo mian na ko'oom ka' men koo parasayamo, gause i koo inti-inti'i mian men nimisiso'kon i koo.

Tio inau'oon uga' se' tempo i koo dauga' morio', koo ninginti'imo Alkitaap men molinas men daa mantarai pinginti'ian na ko'oom. Koo inti'imo na Alkitaap se' mian salamatkonon kalu parasaya ni Kristus Yesus.
Giigii' men nitulis na Alkitaap nimpu'u na Alaata'ala. Alkitaap kumana' bo pimisiso', bo pompopo'inti'ikon men sala', bo pontotobo'i men sala', ka' bo pimisiso'kon wawau men kana'.
Mbaka' mianna Alaata'ala toropotion kada' momoko mingilimang giigii' men pore.
